-Support the addition of viduq3-pro model for start-end2video -Efficiently generate high-quality audio and video content, making the video content more vivid, vivid, and three-dimensional -You can check the unit price on the pricing page February 04,2026 [Added Action Synchronization Capability] -Input action reference video+character image to generate a video of the character moving according to the reference video -10 points per second [Add One stop solution Scenario] -It supports One Click For General Films and is applicable to various Internet scenes such as romantic dramas, live dramas, advertisements, documentaries, etc -Support One Click For AD-Films, helping you quickly create product promotional videos -Support One Click For AI MV, upload audio files+images, and generate beautiful MV videos with composite audio scenes for you -Support One Click For Trending Replicate, upload original videos, product or model images, and quickly replicate popular videos for you January 27,2026 New Model -Support the addition of viduq3-pro models for both Wensheng and Tusheng -Efficiently generate high-quality audio and video content, making the video content more vivid, vivid, and three-dimensional -You can check the unit price on the pricing page January 27,2026 New Models - Added viduq2-pro model（Reference To Video） - Support editing and creation of original videos, image reference videos, video reference videos, etc., to achieve repeated creation of video materials - You can check the cost on the pricing page December 02,2025 New Models - Added viduq2-pro-fast model - Faster speed, lowest price, stable quality, supporting Image to Video and Start end to Video - You can check the cost on the pricing page December 01,2025 New Model Abilities - Viduq2 models upgraded new abilities: Reference to image, Text to image and image editing. - The invocation methods and examples of the model’s new abilities can be found in the API references. - You can check the cost on the pricing page November 13, 2025 New Audio&Video Direct Output Capability - Audio&video direct output is now available for Vidu Reference to Video and Image to Video. - You can configure subjects and their spoken lines using the subjects and audio parameters. - For details, please refer to the API documentations.New Digital Human Capability - Upload a digital human image along with text/voice input to generate a talking-avatar video. - This capability supports selecting a custom voice. - For more information, please see the API documentation.Vidu Q2 Duration Upgrade - The Vidu Q2 model now supports 9-second and 10-second durations. - This duration upgrade applies to Text to Video, Reference to Video, and Image to Video interfaces. - Pricing for the new durations can be found in the pricing . November 3, 2025 Important Update – Vidu Credit Inflation⚠️ Must read! Major update! - Starting November 3, 2025, all credits on the Vidu open platform will undergo a 10× denomination adjustment. - Your credit balance and all credit consumption across APIs will be multiplied by 10. - This adjustment only changes the numerical denomination — the actual value of your credits remains the same. - For details, please refer to the Credit Inflation Notice.New Video Replacement API - You can now use this feature to replace people, objects, or animals in a video with specified content. - Click Video Replacement Example to view sample results. - Check the Audio Generation API for detailed usage and parameters. New Multi-Frame API - You can now set multiple keyframes to achieve smooth transitions and scene continuity between different scenes. - Suitable for long-form videos with multiple scene transitions; supports uploading up to 9 keyframe images. - For detailed usage, please refer to the corresponding API documentation. New Parameter - Added new parameter: is_rec . - This parameter can provide you with recommended prompts to generate videos. - This applies to Image to Video and Start end to Video. - Costs 10 points for each call. October 30, 2025 New APIVidu Text to Speech and Vidu Voice Clone are lunched: - Choose from hundreds of voice styles with customizable emotion, speed, and tone. - Clone your own voice for personalized audio generation. - Check the Audio Generation API for detailed usage and parameters. October 21, 2025 New Model Abilities - Viduq2 models upgraded new abilities: Reference to video, Text to video and Video extension. - The invocation methods and examples of the model's new abilities can be found in the API references. - You can check the cost on the pricing page September 24, 2025 New Models - Added viduq2-pro and viduq2-turbo models - Faster speed, better quality, supporting Image to Video and Start end to Video - You can check the cost on the pricing page September 17, 2025 New Parameter Enhancement - The prompt parameter in the request body now supports up to 2000 characters. - This applies to Image to Video, Reference to video, Start end to Video, Text to Video, Template and Reference to Image. You can check the API documentations for more details. September 16, 2025 New Request URLStarting from September 16, 2025, the request address for Template will be updated as follows: - Original address: https://api.vidu.com/ent/v2/template2video - New address: https://api.vidu.com/ent/v2/template Note: This change does not affect the way template2video is called. You can continue using the original address to initiate requests. September 11, 2025 New Templates - Scenario Example Center added 7 templates - "Pokémon Transformation", "Mini Clone Pickup", "Werewolf Transformation", "Monster Hunter", "High-speed Running - Pet", "Anywhere Resize Kiss - Q1 10s", "Anywhere Resize Kiss - 8s" September 8, 2025 New Feature - Image Task: Added reference image generation - Supports uploading 1–7 images - Image resolution up to 1080p - Costs 20 points per useNew Templates - Scenario Example Center added 5 multi-parameter image generation templates - "Product Background Replacement", "Custom Figure Transformation", "Necklace Wearing", "Character Holding Product (Beauty & Personal Care)", "Character Holding Product (Beverages & Alcohol)" August 26, 2025 New Feature - Video Task: Added reference video generation - Supports uploading 1–7 images - Supports selection of viduq1, vidu2.0, vidu1.5 models August 7, 2025 New Parameter - Video Task: Added off-peak mode off_peak - Using off-peak mode reduces credit cost by 50% - Now supports image-to-video, reference-to-video, text-to-video, and start end to video July 28, 2025 New Capability - Other Task: Added lip-sync capability - Input text/audio to precisely match lip movements in video- Supports free choice of voice tone- 5s video costs 20 credits
